From:
Customer Service <customerservice@coldmountaingear.ie>
To:
Joy Hsaio <hsaioj@zellmail.ie>
Subject:
Order number 94166
Date:
Il July
Dear Ms. Hsaio,
Thank you for your order. The Xtreme Hiking Jacket in gray, women's size Medium, is
currently out of stock. We expect to receive more inventory in about two weeks.
To compensate you for the delay, we will send your order by overnight shipping at no
extra charge as soon as it becomes available. We will inform you when processing is
complete.
-
Yours sincerely,
Cold Mountain Gear Customer Service
